meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

copy.tagline: 将超出单机内存的数据分析任务扩展到分布式集群并行处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据处理量大到单机内存装不下
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的 pandas/NumPy 代码改写成 Dask 版本,让超出内存的数据也能处理,并可并行到多核或多台机器。这些计算是惰性的,调用 .compute() 才真正执行并返回结果。
howto.when: 当你要把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到超出内存,或在多核、多机集群上运行时接管。原文建议:单机 out-of-core 分析用 vaex,追求内存内速度用 polars。

say.text: 用 Dask Futures 把这批参数并行跑一遍,再把结果收集起来

say.text: 数据比内存大,帮我把这段 pandas 代码改成 Dask DataFrame
say.note: 别先用 pandas 读入再交给 Dask

howto.what_en: Claude rewrites your pandas/NumPy code into Dask versions that handle data larger than RAM and parallelize across cores or machines. Operations stay lazy until .compute() is called, which returns the computed result.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or run it across cores or a cluster. The source suggests vaex for single-machine out-of-core analytics and polars for in-memory speed.
